Guided Next-Step Recommendations for AutoIML

Source: R/guide_workflow.R
guide_workflow.Rd

Produces a compact, machine-readable guide with actionable next steps, recommended visualizations, current claim constraints, and reader-facing answers to common interpretation questions derived from gate outcomes and claim semantics.

Usage

guide_workflow(x, max_actions = 6L)

Arguments

x

(AutoIMLResult | AutoIML) A completed result or an AutoIML runner.

max_actions

(integer(1)) Maximum number of actions returned.

Value

Named list with summary, actions, recommended_plots, trust_summary, model_story, and reader_questions.
